items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the pullback formula for principal divisors along an etale morphism at source lines 1679-1690, label lemma-etale-pullback-principal-divisor, whose proof occupies source lines 1692-1803. The proof has two independent halves: a cycle-theoretic reduction that the two sides have the same dimension and that equality can be checked coefficient by coefficient at generic points, using the scheme theoretic image and the commutativity of henselization with the morphism, and a local computation of the coefficient as a difference of lengths over the total rings of fractions of henselized reduced local Noetherian rings, which are not assumed to be domains. The local half then needs the flat unramified ring map to equate lengths over base and total space, an additivity statement for lengths over the quotients by the nonmaximal primes, and the observation that the index set splits as the disjoint union over the components. The counted statement records neither the coefficient comparison nor the length identity.
